description: The connected person's shopping list as Scout priced it at their home Kroger: each item with product, size, price and whether it is on sale, plus the running total. Non-private lists include a revocable share link that expires after seven days. Use for 'what's on my list', 'how much will groceries be', 'is anything on sale'. Needs a connected account.
name: my_list
title: My priced list
